interpretation: The existing candidate axis assumes protonated precursors. Explicit FBMN neutral masses show that most annotated-query candidates are chemically incompatible; missing ion annotations cannot be silently treated as [M+H]+. Strict biological identity links must therefore use only explicit neutral-mass-compatible candidates until an adduct-aware candidate universe is built.
claim_boundary: FBMN best-ion and neutral-mass fields are phenotype-blind annotations, not definitive adduct truth.
Adduct-unresolved queries are abstentions for strict identity use, not proven incompatible.
This audit invalidates strict biological interpretation of the original candidate universe; it does not invalidate spectrum-only benchmarking on its stated [M+H]+ task.
